job_description:
Machine Learning Engineer

Requirements
- 3+ years of experience training and deploying machine learning models in production
- Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Experience with MLOps tooling such as MLflow, Kubeflow or SageMaker
- Solid understanding of statistics and experiment design
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP)
- Ability to communicate results to non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have
- Publications or open-source contributions in ML
